The Hearth's Ashen Shadow

Arlecchino Banner

Type

Character Event Wishes

Char­ac­ter

Arlecchino
The Hearth's Ashen Shadow is a Character Event Wish with the 5 Star Character "Dire Balemoon" Arlecchino (Pyro) as the promoted character with an increased chance to be obtained.

History[]

The Hearth's Ashen Shadow has 4 occurrences:

Image Name Start End Version
The Hearth's Ashen Shadow 2024-04-24 April 24, 2024 May 14, 2024 4.6
The Hearth's Ashen Shadow 2025-01-21 January 21, 2025 February 11, 2025 5.3
The Hearth's Ashen Shadow 2025-11-11 November 11, 2025 December 2, 2025 Luna II
The Hearth's Ashen Shadow 2026-08-12 August 12, 2026 September 1, 2026 7.0

Trivia[]

  • All occurrences of this Wish Series have run alongside an Epitome Invocation Wish featuring Crimson Moon's Semblance, a weapon that both is tailored to Arlecchino's gameplay mechanics and can transform into a scythe only when wielded by Arlecchino.
